en-US.name: PPT Master
en-US.summary: Native PowerPoint generation skill with scripts, templates and Python dependencies inside skills/ppt-master. Requires Python and the declared packages; optional model or TTS providers need the operator's own credentials and fees. One bundled wav file is just over 1 MiB.
en-US.description: Pinned at 63a03673d5c3c928e7f52983a2c8ec65bac30002. The catalog path is the self-contained skills/ppt-master tree, not the whole 13k-file repository (docs/ and projects/ include large examples). Root LICENSE is MIT. skills/ppt-master/templates/sounds/bigsoundbank/0573.wav is about 1.03 MiB. This is not a runtime deck-generation acceptance.

zh-CN.name: PPT Master
zh-CN.summary: 原生 PowerPoint 生成技能，脚本、模板和 Python 依赖位于 skills/ppt-master。需 Python 及已声明的依赖包；可选的模型或语音服务需自备凭据并承担费用。自带的一个 wav 文件略超过 1 MiB。
zh-CN.description: 固定版本 63a03673d5c3c928e7f52983a2c8ec65bac30002。目录路径是自包含的 skills/ppt-master，而不是整个约 1.3 万文件的仓库（docs/ 与 projects/ 含大型示例）。根 LICENSE 为 MIT。skills/ppt-master/templates/sounds/bigsoundbank/0573.wav 约 1.03 MiB。此准入不代表幻灯片生成运行验收。

requirements.value: Requires Python and the packages listed in skills/ppt-master/requirements.txt. The skill directory also has its own LICENSE copy.
Optional LLM, search or TTS providers named in .env.example need the operator's own accounts, credentials and billing; they are not bundled.
